_what: Which run directory this page is built from, and which files outside it the panels may read. Nothing else differs by sample: the title and the one-line description of the water are derived from experiments/libraries.json by experiments/page_descriptor.py, so a sample nobody has touched gets its page without anybody writing a sentence for it. Stating title or sample.lede here overrides the derived one and is recorded as an override.

spectrum.not_run: the gene-level divergent stage (experiments/divergent_known.py) has not been run on this library
